name: government
description: Government contracting and RFP automation testing with mock SAM.gov listings, solicitation documents, NAICS/PSC codes, and compliance requirements

scenarioGenerators.name: rfp-processing
scenarioGenerators.prompt: Generate test scenarios for processing government RFPs from SAM.gov. Include solicitation parsing, deadline extraction, eligibility assessment, and NAICS matching.

scenarioGenerators.name: compliance-check
scenarioGenerators.prompt: Generate scenarios testing compliance validation for government proposals. Include FAR/DFARS checks, set-aside requirements, and past performance verification.

constraints.name: far-compliance
constraints.description: All scenarios reference valid FAR/DFARS regulation clauses

constraints.name: naics-accuracy
constraints.description: NAICS codes must be valid 6-digit codes from official registry

constraints.name: deadline-handling
constraints.description: Agents must correctly parse and respect submission deadlines in various formats
